PRELIMINARY ENGINEERING — NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION | All ratings preliminary pending OEM data, utility studies and approvals
GEORGIA POWER / SOUTHERN COMPANY 115 kV TRANSMISSION SYSTEM

115 kV gen-tie (length/conductor TBD — none if POI is at project yard)

52-H1 115 kV SF₆/SF₆-free dead-tank, 123 kV, 550 kV BIL, 1200 A min., interrupting TBD (≥ SoCo fault level)

Z ≈ 8–12 % on 125 MVA (TBD) | YNd1 preliminary (TBC with SoCo) | OLTC ±10 % HV (TBC by Q study)
HV 627.6 A / MV 2,091.8 A at 125 MVA | 550 kV / 200 kV BIL | 63 SPR, 71, 26/49, DGA monitor
34.5 kV PROJECT MV COLLECTOR BUS — 38 kV class metal-clad, 150 kV BIL, 3000 A bus, 40 kA sym. / 104 kA peak (prelim.)
TYPICAL WTG (each of 27) — OEM SCOPE, DATA TBC
GE Vernova 3.8 MW DFIG (model TBC, e.g. 3.8-154), 0.69 kV, 60 Hz | 4.0 MVA @0.95 PF (screening)
Pad-mount 0.69/34.5 kV ≥ 4.0 MVA (OEM rating, Z & vector group TBC) | MV switch/fuse per OEM
I(690 V) = 3,347 A @4.0 MVA | I(34.5 kV) = 66.9 A | WTG protection & ride-through per OEM
1200 A, 40 kA | CT 600:5 MR C400 (bus side) + 87B CT (line side)
Cable sizes shown in kcmil/AWG Al (screening, ρ = 1.2 K·m/W)
87B (all CTs in zone), 51 partial-diff. backup, arc-flash (light+I), 86B
59N ground detection if non-effectively grounded operation is possible
BESS FEEDER (typ. 4) — 52-B1…B4: 1200 A, 40 kA | CT 600:5 MR C400
Four BESS feeders retained exactly as designed — no change to BESS arrangement
85 DTT / comms (TBD by SoCo), 86, DFR/PMU (per SoCo)
Ride-through settings coordinated with PRC-029-1 / IEEE 2800
PLANT CONTROL / SCADA INTERFACES (see Graphic D)
PPC: closed-loop P, Q/V/PF, f-response, ramp; POI limits +100 / −100 MW
measures CT-2 / 115 kV VT (dedicated cores; not revenue meter)
PPC ⇄ GE Vernova wind farm controller (27 WTGs, fiber in collector trench)
PPC ⇄ BESS EMS ⇄ PCS (4 feeders) | Relays: IEC 61850 / DNP3
Substation RTU/gateway ⇄ Southern Company EMS (ICCP/DNP3 per SoCo)
Hard-wired runback/trip: 86T, 86B, DTT → WTG & BESS controls
Station service & 125 Vdc battery supply all protection/control
Cable labels = minimum Al conductor size per section (screening): HR = home-run to substation. kcmil unless AWG shown.
1. 27 WTGs on 4 radial feeders: WF-01 = 7, WF-02 = 7, WF-03 = 7, WF-04 = 6 (Σ = 102.6 MW).
2. Exactly 4 BESS feeders (existing design) each via own breaker on the same 34.5 kV bus.
3. GSU 125 MVA is a CANDIDATE only; Z, vector group, taps & cooling stack TBD.
4. POI flow limited by PPC to +100 MW export / −100 MW import. Internal feeder
loading is NOT reduced when wind and BESS flows cancel at the POI.
5. Grid fault level, SoCo POI configuration, metering standard, DTT & telemetry
requirements NOT YET PROVIDED — see Open Items Register.
6. Cable sizes: IEC 60287 screening (ρ = 1.2 K·m/W, 25 °C, 1.0 m, 100 % LF);
lengths not shown (no layout). Final sizing by CYMCAP after thermal survey.
7. MV grounding: YNd1 GSU + zig-zag GT (prelim.); islanded feeders ungrounded → 59N/TOV.
8. Relay functions are typical; final scheme & settings per SoCo standards & studies.
9. WTG pad-mount transformer, MV switch & WTG protection are GE Vernova scope.
WIND + BESS 115 kV PROJECT — OVERALL SLD
Georgia Power / Southern Company — 115 kV POI
